errors.what: report.html has no literal '$45' or '$21600' — uses template placeholders {{zoho_price_per_seat}} / {{zoho_annual_total}}
errors.recovered_by: Updated only data.json; HTML will render correct values via template at render time

problems_and_friction: The protocol specifies editing literal '$45'/'$21600' in report.html, but the file uses Mustache-style template placeholders that reference data.json values — there are no literal dollar amounts to replace. The data.json edits are sufficient for the values to be correct when rendered. No other friction encountered.
context_understood: Zoho CRM per-seat price drops from 45 to 38, annual total from 21600 to 18240, applied surgically to data.json with snapshot and receipt created.
